# What TCGplayer really takes from an order.

> Free TCGplayer seller fee calculator: 10.75% marketplace commission (capped at $75 per product, charged on cards plus shipping) and 2.5% + $0.30 per-order transaction fee. See your payout, profit per order, the price for a target profit, and Pro or pre-February-2026 rates side by side. Nothing leaves your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
